semantics.scope: Offline synthetic historical observations; no live wallet or transaction log was read.
semantics.balances: Historical state is independent from topology.json startup balances. RGB starts equally split, BTC uses declared directional ratios; successful transfers are replayed with exact fee accounting.
semantics.reverseFees: Synthetic historical assumption: reverse base fee equals the declared forward base fee; both proportional fees are zero.
semantics.directions: nodeHistories holds endpoint incoming/outgoing observations. Forwarding nodes and actual per-hop amounts are in transaction paths.
semantics.episodes: Each entry.episode exactly matches TelemetryEpisode. MPP produces one observation per part. Failed attempts produce outgoing observations only.
semantics.identifiers: Aliases are fictional topology labels. Pubkeys are constructed valid curve points with no private key created; channel and asset identifiers are synthetic. Rebind identifiers for live-node tests.
